title: What would prove an erased distinction gone for good?
summary: The synthesis of the phase-splice / source-recoder frontier: finite silence is not permanence, an exact sofic orbit-inclusion certificate is what permanence would need, and a ladder of proof grammars up to a bounded adaptive finite-state recoder produced no certificate. The proposed closure is conditional on a recovery that has not finished.
takeaway: Separate a wall in your proof representation from a fact about the dynamics. The lineage is archived incomplete at 14/22 exact classifications; eight unresolved cases are a resource limit, not negative evidence or a spending obligation.

title: Why the exact recovery is still at 0 of 8
kind: Recovery campaign status and negative resource finding
summary: A fresh campaign on the frozen exact-recovery protocol added about 9.3 recorded solver-hours, 721 exact partition splits and 715 closed cylinders, and decided no structural tuple. All eight seeds sit at output position 0 of their first uncompleted tuple, on queries with 39 to 54 free source-background bits and no direct-evaluation leaf ever reached.
takeaway: The lineage is archived incomplete at 14/22: the decomposition is exact and the controls reproduce, but the remaining workload is wide. The eight unresolved cases are not negative results and are not queued without a method gain.
